parameters.query:
SELECT json_build_object(
  'totals', (SELECT json_build_object(
    'count_total', count(*),
    'count_draft', count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='draft'),
    'count_sent', count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('sent','ready_to_sign','partially_signed')),
    'count_signed', count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='signed'),
    'count_expired_unsigned', count(*) FILTER (WHERE status NOT IN ('signed','cancelled','rejected','expired') AND expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at < now()),
    'amount_signed_30d', round(coalesce(sum(amount_eur) FILTER (WHERE status='signed' AND signed_at > now() - INTERVAL '30 days'), 0)::numeric, 2)
  ) FROM contracts),
  'by_type', coalesce((SELECT json_agg(t.* ORDER BY t.count DESC) FROM (
    SELECT contract_type AS type,
      count(*)::int AS count,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='signed')::int AS signed,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('sent','ready_to_sign','partially_signed'))::int AS awaiting,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='draft')::int AS draft
    FROM contracts
    GROUP BY contract_type
  ) t), '[]'::json),
  'pending_action', coalesce((SELECT json_agg(t.* ORDER BY t.urgency DESC) FROM (
    SELECT c.id::text AS contract_id, c.contract_type, c.title, c.status,
      c.amount_eur, c.created_at, c.sent_at, c.expires_at, c.signer_email,
      p.id::text AS project_id, p.name AS project_name,
      CASE
        WHEN c.status NOT IN ('signed','cancelled','rejected','expired') AND c.expires_at IS NOT NULL AND c.expires_at < now() THEN 100
        WHEN c.status='draft' AND c.created_at < now() - INTERVAL '14 days' THEN 80
        WHEN c.status IN ('sent','ready_to_sign','partially_signed') AND c.sent_at < now() - INTERVAL '7 days' THEN 60
        ELSE 0
      END AS urgency
    FROM contracts c JOIN projects p ON p.id = c.project_id
    WHERE c.status NOT IN ('signed','cancelled','rejected','expired')
    ORDER BY urgency DESC LIMIT 25
  ) t), '[]'::json)
) AS report;
